versions.changelog:
Version 1.3.2 (summary: Security & architectural overhaul; expanded documentation)

- Fully rewrote documentation for precise capabilities, privacy, and boundaries
- Replaced all external access and env handling: no API keys, no bookings/payments, local exports only
- Strict new allowlist and DNS/TLS safety checks for all web resource fetches
- All itinerary file exports go to output/ only; removed deprecated auto-open/browser-launch features
- Added detailed usage references and security test coverage; thoroughly described permissible data flows and user data handling
- Expanded command/installation instructions and file structure references

travel-planner-hy v1.3.1

- 精简技能包，移除第三方预订与支付相关脚本和说明，不再调用途牛/飞猪API、不支持订单创建/支付二维码等功能
- 新增本地生成的行程 HTML 示例文件，输出位置为 output/ 目录，仅做信息展示与跳转，不含订单操作
- 权限及隐私说明调整：仅可选读取高德API Key，无需配置途牛/飞猪API Key，未调用任何会处理用户 PII 或写入非本地 output/ 目录的功能
- 明确能力边界：所有预订/支付均需用户自主在第三方平台完成，技能本身仅提供行程信息规划与展示
新增飞猪Fliggy比价通道、自动跨平台比价、严禁编造数据规则、比价自动嵌入方案输出
